//ForwardProxies: Trust X-Forwarded-* from these proxies (KnownProxies: addresses; KnownNetworks: CIDRs, e.g. the OpenShift pod network the router pods live in). Deployed behind the router this must be enabled or the bus pass submit rate limit keys on the router's address.
//AllowOrigins: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call this API: the webclient's own addresses. Unset means no cross-origin calls; * is refused. appsettings.Development.json allows the local webclient; deployed, the manifests set it per environment.

Strapi.//BaseUrl: Content engine base URL. Set per environment; appsettings.Development.json points at http://localhost:1337.
Strapi.//ApiToken: Scoped read-only Strapi API token granting find + findOne on form-spec. NEVER commit a real value - set it in appsettings.local.json for local dev, or as the env var Myss_Strapi__ApiToken in a container. Unset means anonymous reads, which fail now that the Public role no longer grants form-spec access.

Oidc.//Audience: Expected 'aud'. Omit to default to ClientId - verified 2026-07-27 that a real IDIR token from this client carries aud == azp == the client id. Set to "" only for a realm that mints aud:'account', which disables audience validation and leaves the azp check as the sole guard.
Oidc.//RoleSource: Realm | Client | Both. Both is the safe default until IDIM confirms whether this realm carries roles in realm_access or resource_access.
Oidc.//DeriveClientRoleFromIdp: true (default when unset) grants CLIENT to citizen-IDP sign-ins (bceidbasic, bceidboth without a Business BCeID GUID, bcservicescard, and BcServicesCardIdp) via RoleCalculator - see ADR-0007. Set false only if IDIM mandates CSS-managed citizen roles. The citizen/worker cross-line stripping is hardening and applies regardless.
Oidc.//BcServicesCardIdp: The identity_provider value a BC Services Card sign-in carries. CSS names that broker after the integration's client id, so unset defaults to ClientId; set it only if a token shows otherwise.
Oidc.//ServiceAccount: The client this API authenticates as when it calls another service as itself (today the ICM middleware): a confidential CSS integration with its service account enabled, separate from ClientId above, which is the web client whose citizen tokens this API accepts. Set ServiceAccount:ClientId/ClientSecret in appsettings.local.json or as Myss_Oidc__ServiceAccount__ClientId/ClientSecret, never in source control. The token endpoint derives from Authority; set ServiceAccount:TokenEndpoint only to override it.

//ClamAv: clamd endpoint (Host, Port, TimeoutSeconds) used to virus-scan uploads.

Attachments.//: Upload acceptance rules. MaxSizeBytes must stay at or below clamd's StreamMaxLength.

//ObjectStorage: S3-compatible store for uploaded files (ServiceUrl, Bucket, AccessKey, SecretKey, ForcePathStyle). Required: the app refuses to start without it.
//Account: PinLockout: after MaxAttempts wrong current PINs in a row, Change PIN is refused (429 with ACCOUNT.PIN.LOCKED) for LockoutMinutes. Counted per account in the database (MYSS-258). PinReset (MYSS-36): the emailed reset link works once, for TokenLifetimeMinutes (env var Myss_Account__PinReset__TokenLifetimeMinutes); LinkBaseUrl is the webclient's public URL the link opens (https; http only for localhost), set per environment (Myss_Account__PinReset__LinkBaseUrl) and checked at the first reset request. RequestCooldownSeconds: one reset email per account per this many seconds (429 with ACCOUNT.PIN_RESET.TOO_SOON inside it), counted in the database.
//Notify: BC Gov Notify, the email service (MYSS-36). BaseUrl is the service root without /api/v1 (env var Myss_Notify__BaseUrl). ApiKey is the MySS tenant's key, sent as X-API-KEY: NEVER commit a value - set it in appsettings.local.json for local dev, or as Myss_Notify__ApiKey in a container. Both are checked at the first send, which fails with a logged reason when either is missing.
//BusPass: SubmitRateLimit throttles the anonymous bus pass submit route per client address (PermitLimit per WindowSeconds; 429 with BUSPASS.SUBMIT.RATE_LIMITED beyond it). Every accepted submission files a service request in ICM. Behind the router the client address comes from the forwarded headers, so ForwardProxies must be enabled there.
//IcmApi: The ICM middleware (IcmApi) this API calls over REST for anything ICM-bound; ICM's own credentials live there, never here. BaseUrl is required: the app refuses to start without it (env var Myss_IcmApi__BaseUrl). The token this API presents to the middleware is its own service account, configured under Oidc:ServiceAccount.
//FeatureManagement: Citizen features switched on per environment (see Configuration/FeatureFlags.cs). A flag that is not set is off, so every feature is off until an environment turns it on, e.g. Myss_FeatureManagement__BusPass=true. An endpoint whose flag is off never runs, and the webclient hides its pages (GET /v1/features).
